name: Retaking of La Regional Prison Complex
detail: Following Fito's escape, armed forces and police retake control of prison facilities across Guayaquil and other cities in the days after Jan 9, 2024, as part of the initial 'internal armed conflict' response.

name: TC Televisión Hostage Rescue Operation
detail: Police retake the TC Televisión studio in Guayaquil and free hostages held by armed gunmen during the live broadcast takeover, without casualties among hostages.

name: Authorization of Joint Military-Police Patrols
detail: The April 2024 referendum formally authorizes joint military-police street patrols nationwide, a central pillar of the government's security operations going forward.

name: Metástasis Case Arrests and Prosecutions
detail: Attorney General Diana Salazar's office arrests and prosecutes a corruption network of judges, prosecutors, and prison officials tied to drug trafficker Leandro Norero, resulting in 20 convictions by November 2024.

name: Europol-Ecuador Cocaine Network Takedown
detail: Joint operation dismantles a transnational network shipping cocaine to Belgium, Germany, and the Netherlands; 50 suspects arrested and 73 tons of cocaine seized cumulatively.

name: Fito Recapture Operation, Manta
detail: Ecuadorian security forces locate and capture Adolfo 'Fito' Macías in an underground bunker beneath a house in Manta, 17 months after his prison escape.

name: Fito Extradition Handover
detail: Macías is transferred from Guayaquil's maximum-security prison to the airport and handed to US federal authorities, the first-ever extradition of an Ecuadorian citizen from Ecuador to the US.

name: Posorja Port Interdiction Operations
detail: Ongoing container and vessel inspection operations at the Posorja deep-water port aimed at intercepting cocaine shipments before they reach international waters.

name: Capture of Alias 'Gato Negro' in Colombia
detail: Colombian authorities capture Galo Javier Suárez Román, alias 'Gato Negro,' second-in-command of Los Tiguerones and a suspect in a plot against Interior Minister Reimberg, who is subsequently transferred to Ecuador and imprisoned at El Encuentro.

name: Joint US-Ecuador Operations Against Designated Terrorist Groups
detail: Ecuadorian and US forces launch coordinated operations against Los Choneros, Los Lobos, and affiliated networks, marking the most direct US operational involvement in Ecuadorian territory since the conflict began.
